extension.description: An AI-powered Git assistant for safer commits, conflict prevention, and smarter workflow guidance in VS Code.

command.clearGitHubToken.title: GitCat: Clear GitHub Token
config.branchCleanup.enabled.description: Enable or disable Branch Cleanup features.
config.branchCleanup.olderThanValue.desc: Treat branches older than this value as cleanup candidates.
config.branchCleanup.olderThanUnit.descr: Time unit for olderThanValue (week or month).
config.branchCleanup.deleteMergedBranche: Include already merged local branches in deletion candidates.
config.branchCleanup.deleteGoneRemoteBra: Include local branches whose tracked remote branch is gone in deletion candidates.
config.branchCleanup.protectedBranches.d: Protected branches that should never be deleted.
config.language.description: Controls the language used for GitCat UI text. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language.
config.ai.mode.description: Configure the AI inference mode. 'live-local' uses a local GGUF model, and 'live-remote' uses the remote GMS API.
config.ai.localModelPath.description: Absolute path to the GGUF model file used for live-local inference. On Windows, use a path such as C:\Models\Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct.gguf.
config.ai.remoteBaseUrl.description: Gateway base URL or OpenAI-compatible base URL used for live-remote inference. Example: https://gms.ssafy.io/gmsapi/ or https://example.com/v1
config.ai.remoteModel.description: Model name used for live-remote inference. Example: gpt-4o-mini
config.safety.largeDeletionThreshold.des: Threshold for the number of deleted files before the Safety Layer raises a large deletion warning.
config.merge.openMainPanelOnConflict.des: Automatically open the GitCat main panel when Push/Pull/PR guards or merge analysis detect a conflict.
